lines.en: I shuffle forward along the riverbed.
The current shoves me from side to side.
My feet sink into the soft mud.
I walk toward the light on the shore.
My swollen skin scrapes along the stones.
Weeds catch around my leg once.
I move slowly; the water is heavy.

lines.zh: 每一步都带起一团浑水。
lines.en: Every step stirs up a cloud of silt.
I hear the sound of oars.
I step on planks from a sunken boat.
I walk from deep water toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 上岸之前我得先晾一晾。
lines.en: Before landing I must dry out a little.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: Soaking in water, I slowly swell up.

lines.zh: 气泡从我衣领里冒出来。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from inside my collar.
I count the driftwood floating on the surface.
Water fills my lungs; it is quiet.
I press the small tumor on my shoulder.
A fish is nibbling at my toes.

lines.zh: 我等着河水把我往下推。
lines.en: I wait for the river to push me along.

lines.zh: 我的头发像水草一样飘。
lines.en: My hair floats like waterweed.
Mycelium grows slower underwater.

lines.zh: 我记得自己溺死的那天。
lines.en: I remember the day I drowned.
I spit out a mouthful of sandy water.
Light leaks down from above.
I listen to the sounds of the riverbed.
Drifting is not so bad.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的脚，我没挣。
lines.en: Weeds wrap my feet, and I do not pull free.

lines.zh: 我身上的瘤又大了一点。
lines.en: The growth on me is a little larger.

lines.zh: 隔着水，我听见岸上有人。
lines.en: Through the water I hear someone on the bank.

lines.zh: 我把孢子吐在水里，慢慢散。
lines.en: I spit spores into the water and let them spread.
You stand on the bank and see me.
You hesitate at the water's edge.
Your boots are going to fill with water.
Only my eyes break the surface near you.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把照到我了。
lines.en: The torch in your hand finds me.
I am measuring how far you are from water.
You crouch down to peer into the water.
Your reflection sees me before you do.
I wait for you to reach into the water.
You smell of dry earth, not river water.
Your steps make the water tremble.
Do not blink; I am going under.

lines.zh: 你的剑在水里慢了一半。
lines.en: Your sword is half as fast underwater.
My blood turns the water green.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里不疼，只是凉。
lines.en: Underwater the wound only feels cold.

lines.zh: 我一沉一浮，血在水里散开。
lines.en: I bob up and down as blood spreads in the water.
You split one of my tumors open.

lines.zh: 孢子散在水里，到处都是。
lines.en: Spores scatter through the water everywhere.

lines.zh: 我退了半米，水替我挡了。
lines.en: I fall back a meter; water shields me.
Your aim is good, but the water is murky.
I hold your boot and will not let go.
Pain makes me dive deeper.

lines.zh: 你腰上那袋东西在滴水。
lines.en: That bag at your waist is dripping.
I know the smell of raw fish best.
You are carrying a fish in your hand.
I smell blood, and it is in the water.
Give it here; I will tow your boat.
That string of bait makes me restless.
I will come ashore just for that bite.
Do not throw the fish back in.
Everything in the water belongs to me.
Come closer; I cannot reach it.
You crash into the water; perfect.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花很大。
lines.en: We collide and send up a big splash.
Your heel presses into my shoulder.
I am more agile than you in water.
Do not push; my tumors may rupture.
You slip, and I steady you.
Collisions underwater make no sound at all.
You kicked me in the ribs.
I hug your legs and pull us down.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，谁也跑不了。
lines.en: We are too close for either to escape.

lines.zh: 水里还有另一个我在漂。
lines.en: Another one like me drifts in the water.
We sink side by side to the riverbed.
I give you half of my spores.
Your tumors are bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 同一条河养出我们两个。
lines.en: One river raised the two of us.
I wait for you to rise from the deep.
Let us guard this crossing together.
Nobody disturbs us underwater.
Your fingers are colder than river stones.
The tide is out; we huddle in the mud.
There is an iron scrap on the riverbed.
I pick up a nail from the sunken boat.
This fishing line still works.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进肿胀的肚子。
lines.en: I push it into my swollen belly.
I collect everything that sinks down here.
My fingers find a gold coin.
I pick it up and find it is bone.
I tuck the iron scrap into my belt.
Whatever floats down here is a gift.

lines.zh: 捞东西的时候我不看上面。
lines.en: I do not look up while salvaging.
You step into the shallows; my chance comes.
I choose the one who cannot swim.
Your boat's hull is right above me.
Your torch cannot light the water below.

lines.zh: 那个在洗东西的最松懈。
lines.en: The one washing things is most off guard.
You are bleeding right now.
I fix on the one who fell in.
You have stood at the water too long.
I raise my eyes above the surface.
Close enough; I begin to sink.
I slip along the riverbed around you.
First I touch you, then plant a tumor.
Two and a half seconds; you can count it.
I wait for you to look down at the water.
Spores will bloom on your skin.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经准备好了。
lines.en: My fingers are already prepared.
You retreat; I rise with you.
If it misses, I simply try again.
The splash will hide what I am doing.
I settle my weight onto my heels.
I get a grip on your ankle.

lines.zh: 你感觉到皮肤下有东西动。
lines.en: You feel something move beneath your skin.
The tumor is planted.
One slap on your back is all it takes.

lines.zh: 我的手指插进你的袖子。
lines.en: My fingers sink into your sleeve.
You shake me off, but it is late.
Mud fills the gaps under my nails.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，重量在后头。
lines.en: This blow is light; the weight comes later.
Do you hear that ticking sound?
I bite into your lower leg.

lines.zh: 我从河泥里撑起半个身子。
lines.en: I push half my body up from the river mud.

lines.zh: 溺死的那具身体还记得水。
lines.en: That drowned body still remembers water.
Mycelium reshaped the corpse in the river.
My first breath is a choke of water.
The riverbed is quieter than the shore.

lines.zh: 我身上的水草还没抖掉。
lines.en: Waterweed still clings to my shoulders.

lines.zh: 溺水那口气还卡在喉咙。
lines.en: That drowning breath is still stuck in my throat.
This stretch of river answers to me.
I open my eyes; the water is green.
The light on the shore bothers me.

lines.zh: 我先在水下站了一会儿。
lines.en: I stood underwater for a while first.
Someone dropped something into the water.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我在下面笑。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I laugh beneath.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔进水里，溅得很远。
lines.en: I fall into the water and splash far.
I stopped needing to breathe long ago.
The blast throws me up out of the water.
The arrow drifts off course in the water.
Magic boils away the water around me.

lines.zh: 我饿的是血肉，不是面包。
lines.en: What I hunger for is flesh, not bread.

lines.zh: 雷击水面，我骨头里都在颤。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and my bones vibrate.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我干得发慌。
lines.en: There is no water in the void; I dry out.
